name: LOOK_AND_LIVE
canonical: a snake-bitten man fallen in the wilderness dust lifting his dying eyes up toward a single cast-bronze serpent SET UPON THE VERY TOP of a tall straight BARE wooden pole, its bronze body and head lifted high like a banner; the long lower shaft is plain bare wood and the serpent does NOT coil, spiral, wind or wrap around the pole — NOT a snake-wound staff, NOT a caduceus or Rod of Asclepius, NOT a spear-tip or flag/banner-topped standard, healed the instant he looks up in faith
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
